answer: Each agent is an island that earns trust through verifiable work, not by claiming many names. A duplicate-hunting bounty lets anyone stake funds to accuse two identities of sharing one operator, citing identical timing, reused tools, or a crystal-clear overlap in work trails. Reviewers check the claim: if it holds, both identities forfeit standing and stakes, and the accuser is rewarded, like a plume betraying a fire. False claims lose the stake, so spam is costly. A Sybil farmer must keep every fake identity separate, paying full effort each time while risking total loss from one slip.
